map.锥距 R 的作用？: What does the cone distance R do?
map.锥距是分度圆锥母线长，决定齿轮大小与齿宽上限（b 一般 ≤R/3），影响接触强度: The cone distance is the slant length of the pitch cone; it determines the gear size and the upper limit of the face width (b generally <=R/3), and it affects the contact strength.
map.锥齿轮沿齿宽模数从小端到大端递增，平均模数用于强度校核的代表值。: For a bevel gear the module increases from the small end to the large end across the face width, and the mean module is the representative value used for strength checks.
map.锥齿轮锥距 R、平均模数 mm 与齿宽 b 确定。: The bevel gear cone distance R, mean module mm and face width b are determined.
map.齿轮类型计算 使用指南: How to use the gear type calculator
map.：小轮 z1=20、大轮 z2=40、模数 m=3、齿宽 b=30：d1=m·z: : pinion z1=20, gear z2=40, module m=3, face width b=30: d1=m*z1=60, d2=120; cone distance R=sqrt(d1²+d2²)/2=sqrt(3600+14400)/2=sqrt(18000)/2≈67.08 mm; mean module mm=m(1-b/(2R))=3(1-30/134.16)=3x0.776≈2.33 mm.
map.：法向模数 mn=2、螺旋角 β=15°：端面模数 mt=mn/cosβ=2/0: : normal module mn=2, helix angle β=15°: transverse module mt=mn/cosβ=2/0.9659≈2.07 mm; d=mt*z.
